what: Hover a photo cell and the inner photo scales up in .75s to the set scale (default 1.1). As the mouse moves inside the cell, the photo is pushed the opposite way from the cursor in .5s by (cell center − cursor) × push share (default .02, or scale × .0182 if a scale is given), so the photo dodges the cursor and steps aside inside the cell. On release it returns to its own size and place in 1s. All power2.out.

options.scale: Scale when enlarged, default 1.1 — brand Hero 1.04
options.move: Push amount (multiplied by distance between cursor and center), default .02 · if scale is given, scale × .01818
options.move-x·move-y: Horizontal and vertical shift shares set separately (Brand Hero .008·.005)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Inner photo that grows and gets pushed — first child if none. Set overflow: hidden on the slot (element)

use: …Photo…

from.where: shared.js [data-hover-thumb] (three hero product photos scale 1.04 · move .008/.005, other product photos in product cards · detail default 1.1 · .02). Original bundle’s hover thumbnail: mouseenter scale .75s, mousemove (center − cursor) × amount .5s, mouseleave 1s, all power2.out
